The top 6 teams from across the season will fight for the championship in a double elimination bracket and qualification to [[2023 Season World Championship|Worlds 2023]]. }}

==Overview==
=== Format ===
* 6 teams participate
** [[LEC/2023 Season/Winter Playoffs|Winter]], [[LEC/2023 Season/Spring Playoffs|Spring]], and [[LEC/2023 Season/Summer Playoffs|Summer]] Season champions
** Top three non-qualified teams in [[LEC/2023 Season/Championship Points|Championship Points]]
* Double elimination bracket
** Seeding is determined by Championship Points
** The 1st seed chooses between the 3rd and the 4th seed as their Round 1 opponent
** The 5th seed will play against the lower seed from the upper bracket Round 1 losers, the 6th seed against the higher seed
* Matches are best of five
* Top 3 teams qualify for the [[2023 Season World Championship]]
* Fourth-placed team qualifies for the [[2023 Worlds Qualifying Series]]
